title: Something strange is happening beneath a volcano near 2 million people
caption:
New satellite observations reveal a complex magma system beneath Nicaragua’s Masaya volcano. By tracking subtle ground movements, experts are gaining a better understanding of how this active site behaves.

Source: Sciencedaily - Something strange is happening beneath a volcano near 2 million people
